data.title: 伽玛 · 深夜阳台的最后一笔账
data.description: 深夜，伽玛披着丝绸睡裙站在寝居阳台上，借着烛光核对最后一页账目。算完这一页，她才能安心睡下——虽然走回床边时还是差点绊到裙角。
data.location: private bedroom balcony at night with moonlight, a small table with ledger and candle
data.action: standing on the balcony checking a ledger by candlelight, silk nightgown, sleepy but stubborn expression
data.lighting: 月光与烛台的微暖光晕
data.promptProse: Past midnight, Gamma balances the last page by candlelight on her balcony — only then may the president sleep.
data.animaCaption: The day's last figure checks out. Gamma yawns, closes the ledger, and nearly trips on her own hem.
